player_prompt.intro:
I ni jɛgɛ {player_id} ye {num_rounds}-kɔnɔ Rock-Paper-Scissors jɛlɛ.
Jɛgɛ fɛnɛ bɛɛ kɛlɛ ka kɔnɔ caman na.
Kɔnɔ kɔnɔ, kɛlɛ ka wale: '[rock]', '[paper]', walima '[scissors]'.
O bɛɛ kɛlɛ ka wale '[r]', '[p]', walima '[s]' jugu.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Iriko te se ka kɛ. Sɛbɛnna [rock], [paper], ane [scissors].

outcome.p0_wins: Jiginɛ 0 ye se sɔrɔ a ka bɔlɔ caman na!
outcome.p1_wins: Jiginɛ 1 ye se sɔrɔ a ka bɔlɔ caman na!
outcome.draw: O bɔlɔlɔ ye kelen de kɛ!
